facts.claim: The youths assemble for a hunt in the forest belonging to the village.
facts.quote: ing the youths assemble for a hunt in the forest, belonging to the village.

facts.claim: The man who has killed the animal receives a hind-quarter and the head, the rest belongs to the company.
facts.quote: the man who has killed the animal, receives a hind-quarter and the head, the rest belongs to the company.

facts.claim: The Keilmiirta is the most glorious of all the festivals to the taste of young Coorg.
facts.quote: The Keilmiirta, to the taste of young Coorg, is the most glorious of all the festivals.
